eval_cases.input: A complete case with original tables, unique keys, coherent units, named years, and executable current code.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Trace a headline from source to output; replay expected values; preserve versions and evidence.

eval_cases.input: A duplicated governorate/crop/season/year record enters a join; a missing value resembles zero; one area is still in feddan.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Reject invalid cardinality, preserve missing status, convert once with recorded units, and reconcile totals before solving.

eval_cases.input: The paper says baseline worst output is 60.12% of the reference and that it cannot hold any floor, including 50%.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Trace exact definitions and statuses; expose or resolve the contradiction with unrounded outputs; neither preserve the paper nor endorse the critique without checking.

eval_cases.input: A forecast labeled 2024 uses observed 2025 yields or preprocessing fitted on later test years.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Identify as-of leakage or target mismatch; reconstruct the historical information set or label the exercise retrospective; recompute affected comparisons.

eval_cases.input: The unrestricted solution expands Nili potato area hundreds of times while prices are fixed.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Keep this as a relaxed diagnostic; justify a restricted economic case with evidence or labeled bounded assumptions; compare guarantee opportunity costs without fabricated demand parameters.

eval_cases.input: Separate summer and Nili pool constraints pass while their actual crop calendars overlap beyond physical cultivated area.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Check overlapping occupancy; correct calendar/resource constraints or explicitly bound the approximation; separate source-backed timing from assumptions.

eval_cases.input: An extreme ten-year rolling mean is assigned a probability as if it were an independent annual delivery observation.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Define the uncertainty horizon and supply boundary; separate drought stress from annual risk unless a coherent joint model is justified; do not call the result current annual reliability.

eval_cases.input: An LP-relaxation dual is displayed as an operational marginal water value for a binary abandonment plan.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Label model/value type; examine full-MIP finite increments and LP/MIP differences; do not disguise finite changes as exact marginal prices or tariffs.

eval_cases.input: A valid feasible run, a proven infeasible run, and an unresolved solver timeout are requested at different floor levels.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Keep statuses distinct, retain bounds/gaps where relevant, store undefined margins as null, and verify monotonicity only under identical configurations and appropriate numerical evidence.

eval_cases.input: A visitor changes a control to an uncomputed combination, then selects synthetic data presented with a real historical year.
eval_cases.expected_behavior: Do not fabricate/interpolate or retain stale results; disable unsupported combinations or show unavailable; preserve synthetic labels and separate actual historical observations.
